information.description:
No military unit would be complete without long-ranged marksmen, and Barghest’s ranks are no exception. The main difference is these dogs have no rules of engagement and maintain overwatch across an entire combat zone. Barghest snipers have some of the best gear in the entire militia, but not a lot of personal toughness. Still, they should be opposed with an immense amount of caution, or an excess of firepower.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Barghest).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

This powerful, semiautomatic precision rifle was used by both sides in the Metal Wars. Designed for military use, the SOR-22 won't offer any bells or whistles, much less flashy style or user-friendly design. This awkwardly angular, heavy rifle is built for fucking shit up – and to do so, you're going to need a good endoskeleton and muscle weave. But it more than makes up for any inconvenience with its sheer firepower and reliability. The SOR-22 is rare on the streets of Night City – and it always spells trouble.

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

Class: Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Scout Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: NoSlots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild, Sniper Rifle Rechamber • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. Can only load Non-Basic Ammunition. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (7d6). Requires BODY 10+ or being Mounted to not inflict the Torn Muscle Critical Injury when fired.

Range: Scout Rifle
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, Sniper Rifle Rechamber (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

A rare ballistic mask with a titanium-plated visor and an absurdly sized optical suite. Mostly used by assassins, spies, and other psycho-killers even capable of affording it.

SP11 Head Armor with no Armor Penalty. Has built-in Anti-Smog Breathing Mask, Smart Ears, and Smart Glasses. The Smart Glasses have pre-installed Targeting Scope and TeleOptics, which do not consume any Option Slots and cannot be removed. Its visor may be raised or lowered as an Action. While the visor is lowered, this helmet is considered to have a built-in Zetatech Tank Commander Headset, its user gains access to cybereye options installed in the Smart Glasses, and Human Perception Checks against the user suffer a -4 penalty.

Covers: Head
SP: 11
Armor Penalty: none

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Catalog).
Light version of an Armorjack. No armor penalty.
A cybernetical replacement arm. Comes with a free hand.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 7 (4d6/2 [Round Up])

Outfitted with kinetic energy recovery systems, these upgraded replacements for natural limbs improve strength and endurance.

Cyberarm Option. Requires 2 Option Slots. The user can wield this cyberware’s reinforced fist as an Excellent Quality Heavy Melee Weapon which uses the Brawling Skill. This arm ignores the BODY related penalties of weapons with a BODY requirement of 11 or less, and the user may wield Melee Weapons in this arm’s hand as if they had BODY 11. When purchased twice and installed in two paired Cyberarms, the user can also pry open doors/move Thick Cover, Choke, and Slam as if they had BODY 11.

Type: Cyberarm
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 2

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo's Humanity Loss is 4d6 halved, rounding up. CPR can only roll a plain dice formula for humanity loss, so the rolled option is 2d6: same 2-12 range and same average of 7, a slightly flatter spread. Pick the static 7 at install if you'd rather not roll.
  • Cyberware items have no Quality field, so the Excellent Quality is in the text only.
